subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox rollout can evict active Docker operations

question: Does https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103553 establish the correct sandbox lifecycle and security boundary for automatic replacement across exec, filesystem bridge, and authenticated browser operations?
rationale: The repair changes forced removal, process supervision, browser retry, cancellation cleanup, and operator recreation behavior; tests cannot determine the intended permanent security and ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve coordinated drain
options.body: Refresh and land the linked PR after security-owner review confirms complete lease coverage, drain ordering, state rechecks, and explicit recreate semantics.

options.title: Narrow the release repair
options.body: Request a smaller lifecycle patch if browser retry or exported coordinator changes exceed what is necessary to prevent active-work eviction.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated drain
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the linked PR after security-owner review confirms complete lease coverage, drain ordering, state rechecks, and explicit recreate semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue assignment and merged/current implementation history provide the strongest available ownership trail for this decision.
